commands.name: Back
commands.description: Return to the main Stream Deck keys.

commands.name: Buy
commands.description: Send a user-mapped broker hotkey once. Fidelity native hotkeys open an order preview and still require Place; they do not satisfy immediate submission.
commands.setup: The current desktop hotkey editor explicitly says complete defaults go to order preview, and Place submits. Immediate execution cannot be provided by a native Fidelity hotkey alone. No extra Enter or guessed screen click is added.
commands.executionNote: BROKER LIMIT · Native Fidelity hotkeys open a preview. Place is still required; this is not immediate submission.

commands.name: Sell
commands.description: Send a user-mapped broker hotkey once. Fidelity native hotkeys open an order preview and still require Place; they do not satisfy immediate submission.
commands.setup: The current desktop hotkey editor explicitly says complete defaults go to order preview, and Place submits. Immediate execution cannot be provided by a native Fidelity hotkey alone. No extra Enter or guessed screen click is added.
commands.executionNote: BROKER LIMIT · Native Fidelity hotkeys open a preview. Place is still required; this is not immediate submission.

commands.name: OTOCO
commands.description: Open the editable entry, profit-target and stop-loss bracket. This button does not send the order.
commands.setup: Verified manual path: Tools > Trade > Stocks dropdown > Conditional > Action > Buy + Sell bracket (OTOCO). Entry, target and stop remain editable. Automatic selection requires accessible app controls, which are not exposed on this PC; a shortcut override must open the editor rather than submit.

commands.name: Trim 1/3
commands.description: Send your configured partial-exit hotkey. The broker must calculate one third of the current position and preserve or resize remaining protection.
commands.setup: Requires a supported, verified broker hotkey. This action has no guessed default. If your broker does not provide it, use Positions / Orders to manage it manually.

commands.name: Stop to B/E
commands.description: Send your configured stop-to-breakeven hotkey. The broker must derive the actual fill price and remaining quantity.
commands.setup: Requires a supported, verified broker hotkey. This action has no guessed default. If your broker does not provide it, use Positions / Orders to manage it manually.

commands.name: Trail stop
commands.description: Open the broker stop editor or send its configured trailing-stop hotkey. Review the remaining size and 5-minute structure.
commands.setup: Requires a supported, verified broker hotkey. This action has no guessed default. If your broker does not provide it, use Positions / Orders to manage it manually.

commands.name: Flatten
commands.description: Hold for one second to send the configured close-position action once. Match its cancel/close behavior in your broker.
commands.setup: Requires a supported, verified broker hotkey. This action has no guessed default. If your broker does not provide it, use Positions / Orders to manage it manually.

commands.name: Cancel orders
commands.description: Hold for one second to send the configured cancel-orders action once. Cancelling protective orders can leave a position unprotected.
commands.setup: Requires a supported, verified broker hotkey. This action has no guessed default. If your broker does not provide it, use Positions / Orders to manage it manually.
